authors: G. Allinson, L. A. Downes, C. S. Adams, K. J. Weatherill
title: Determination of quantum defects and core polarizability of atomic cesium via terahertz and radio-frequency spectroscopy in thermal vapor
method: THz and rf electromagnetically-induced-transparency spectroscopy of Rydberg states in a room-temperature Cs vapor cell (two- and three-photon schemes)
uncertainty: Table IV p->s, p->d: 0.5 MHz unless given; d->f and Table V: per value in parentheses
caveats: row "30p3/2 -> 30s1/2 = -516.1775 GHz" is inconsistent (30p3/2-30s1/2 = -179.43 GHz); the value matches 31p3/2 -> 30s1/2 (-516.21 GHz): probable label typo
thermal vapor measurements; systematic deviations of a few MHz relative to cold-atom data
for l>=5 the J label is omitted (j=l+1/2 assumed by the authors)
